raw_segments.text: Yes, I said, and men of this stamp will be covetous of money, like those who live in
They will have, a fierce secret longing after gold and silver, which they will hoard in
dark places, having magazines and treasuries of their own for the deposit and concealment
Also castles which are just nests for their eggs, and in which they will spend large sums
on their wives, or on any others whom they please.
